description: Source code implementing HMAC (Hash-based Message Authentication Code) functions using OpenSSL, including context management, initialization, update, finalization, and cleanup routines.

classes.name: HMAC_CTX
classes.description: Structure representing the context for HMAC operations, including message digest contexts and the digest algorithm.

methods.name: HMAC
methods.description: Performs HMAC operation with given message digest, key, data, and outputs the result.

methods.name: HMAC_CTX_new
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new HMAC_CTX structure.

methods.name: HMAC_CTX_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up and frees resources associated with an HMAC_CTX.

methods.name: HMAC_CTX_cleanse
methods.description: Cleanses sensitive data from an HMAC_CTX structure.

methods.name: HMAC_Init_ex
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes an HMAC_CTX with a key and digest.

methods.name: HMAC_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the HMAC computation and outputs the result.

methods.name: HMAC_size
methods.description: Returns the size of the HMAC output for a given context.

methods.name: HMAC_CTX_get_md
methods.description: Returns the digest algorithm used in the context.

methods.name: HMAC_CTX_copy_ex
methods.description: Copies the state from one HMAC_CTX to another.

methods.name: HMAC_CTX_reset
methods.description: Resets an HMAC_CTX to its initial state.

methods.name: HMAC_Init
methods.description: Simplified initialization of HMAC context with key and digest.

methods.name: HMAC_CTX_copy
methods.description: Copies an HMAC_CTX from source to destination.
